verdict.rationale: Composio provides a hosted MCP server (Composio Connect) at a fixed URL (https://connect.composio.dev/mcp) that any MCP-compatible client can point at to reach 1000+ downstream apps without deploying infrastructure, and also supports creating custom hosted MCP session URLs via mcp:true. Docs and probes confirm the server is live and documented as a single-URL connection requiring no SDK/session setup. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a client successfully connecting and executing tools end-to-end (only one unrelated community complaint about a specific Instagram auth failure, not about the MCP hosting itself).
